summary_1line: After Vaka’s death the Pandavas stay in Ekachakra, hear a traveling Brahmana recount Draupadi’s birth and the early history of Drona and Drupada.

image_candidates.scene_text: The Pandavas sit with Kunti in a humble Brahmana’s house at Ekachakra listening intently to a traveling ascetic narrate distant kingdoms and marvels.
On the Ganga’s bank the wind disrobes the apsara Ghritachi as the sage Bharadwaja, overcome by sudden desire, captures his seed in a pot.
Parashurama stands in austere calm handing his divine weapons and their secret mantras to the eager young Drona.
